title: Exclude one-slot Type B even-idle fusion (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On the exact 17-stage #7113 caller under the complete #7277 invoice, all 1,348 Type B disjoint-mask even IDLE_ONE pairs fail the necessary projector equality for one grouped idle at any clock and single role. The 544 singleton pairs are a reproduced subset. Both scopes exhausted with zero unresolved.

At unit body values, deleting and inserting even idles leaves all other specialized factors unchanged. The disjoint stage derivatives require the new idle's projector to equal both old normalized projectors. An independent exact rational implementation verifies the primary modular exclusions at both q signs. The complete directed price is saved first. The optimistic compatible-stock uppers are 5.45030389 raw units for the singleton scope and 35.71990805 for the full scope. The support gate reduces each to zero.

## Task and overlap

Round 52–53 of Discussion #7111. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The caller is #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`, and the comparator is #7277 at `ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea` (κ = 0.003645669928698). The earlier 1,984-pair test in #7111 applies the same criterion to the 18-stage #7108 caller. This package refines the scope to the 17-stage Type B inventory and adds exact independent arithmetic and the complete price. The branch retains both hosted-replay prerequisite commits from #7257 with original authorship.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-even-idle-projector-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-even-idle-projector-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
```

Seven exact public sources are bundled. Registered replay, committed-byte/mode/source authentication, Git-free export replay, and six navigation tests passed locally. Corrupting the caller was rejected. The package authenticates six deterministic receipts and can emit them with `--out fresh-receipts`. Hosted and separate historical replay remain pending at submission.

## Credit

#7113 supplies the signed caller and interface, #7277 the complete comparable witness and invoice, #7108 and Discussion #7111 the earlier conjugacy screen, and #7003/#7002 the derivative-projector lineage. #7144, #7295, #7296 and #7305 supply related fixed-caller, price and BIT precedents. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

The rest of the caller is fixed. Multi-role replacements, changes to other events, and other idle classes remain open. The package notes which derivative equations would have to change for a broader construction.
